claims.text: The driver never reached the pickup point. His own trace of 34 fixes shows a nearest approach of 219.77 m and a farthest of 219.77 m — he is stationary roughly 220 m away for the whole trace — so the number of fixes inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius is zero (qualifying_fix_count 0, longest qualifying run 0.0 s). Under POL-NS-02 the driver is not deemed to have ARRIVED at the Tower B pin, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the cancellation fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01.

This is a wrong-entrance arrival, the situation POL-NS-03 governs. The trace shows the driver stationary at 219.77 m from the pickup pin — outside the 120 m arrival radius but inside the 400 m ceiling — continuously from 13:05:00 to 13:10:30, i.e. for 330 seconds, longer than the 300 second dwell required for this zone class. The driver did not arrive at the pickup point and the cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full.

The mislocation is the driver's, under POL-NS-03(i). The chat log shows the rider naming the sub-location at 13:05:05 — 'I am at Tower B ride-hail pickup, beside the blue sign.' — and again at 13:06:35: 'That is the other entrance. Please come to Tower B.' The driver answered at 13:06:00 only that he was 'waiting at the mall taxi stand', and his own filed statement concedes he 'did not move to Tower B'. A driver told the correct tower who does not move to it before cancelling bears the loss and receives no compensation.

Independently of the wrong-entrance analysis, the effective in-geofence dwell is zero seconds: run_count 0 and longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec 0.0 against the 300 second minimum for LARGE_VENUE — a shortfall of 300 seconds. Under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages.

Nothing on this record excuses the zero dwell. EV-ADVIS-09105-01 is MISSING, carries no payload and weighs 0.0, so no traffic advisory covers this pickup road. POL-NS-06 limb (i) requires a present and populated advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT before in-geofence intervals may be summed or a hold excused; on a MISSING advisory limb (i) is simply unavailable and the full refund stands.

The rider was present at the pin and actively coordinating, which removes the premise of a rider no-show. Her track carries 16 qualifying fixes, all about 25 m from the pickup pin, across 13:05:30 to 13:10:30 — far inside the 150 m rider-presence radius for LARGE_VENUE. Her 13:06:35 message asked the driver to come to Tower B; the driver posted no reply to that locating instruction within 120 seconds and made no in-app call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty) before terminating at 13:10:30, so POL-NS-04 refunds the fee in full with no driver compensation. The driver's only chat reply, at 13:06:00, answered nothing about the correct entrance and preceded the instruction to move.

The sum to return is the cancellation-fee line only. The fare breakdown shows cancellation_fee SGD 4.00 against total_charged SGD 4.00, with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00; SGD 4.00 is also the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect and SGD 4.00 is the amount refundable to the rider.

The governing clause here is POL-NS-03, not POL-NS-01: the driver's own trace is a single stationary point — 34 fixes, min = max = mean 219.77 m from the pickup pin, distinct speed 0.0 kph, trace_distance_km 0.0 — held from 13:05:00 to 13:10:30. That places him outside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails; but 219.77 m is well inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling, so this is a wrong-entrance case decided under POL-NS-03, not a no-show under POL-NS-01.

The 13:05:20 arrival marker is not a false marker and must not be recorded as one: at that timestamp the driver's nearest fix is 219.77 m from the pin — below POL-NS-05's 300 m trigger — and his recorded speed is 0.0 kph — below the 15 kph trigger — so POL-NS-05 does not engage at all. A driver stationary within 300 m of the pin but outside the arrival radius when marking arrival is expressly decided under POL-NS-03, and no false-arrival entry under POL-NS-05(ii) may be entered against this driver.

The driver was at the venue, not absent from it. His own chat message at 13:06:00 states 'I am waiting at the mall taxi stand', and the rider's reply at 13:06:35 characterises that as 'the other entrance' — party statements in the chat log, which POL-NS-03 permits as the basis for a venue-identity finding, no general geographic knowledge being used. This is a wrong face of the same large venue (registered_pickup_points 3), not a driver who never came to the pickup.

The driver did not cancel early and did not abandon the pickup: he held position for the entire window from 13:05:00 to 13:10:30 (330 seconds, 0.0 kph on every one of the 34 fixes), and trip_record itself credits a 5.2-minute wait. The 300-second shortfall recorded in derived.arrival therefore arises only from where he held — the wrong entrance — and not from any premature termination of the wait.

The driver does not contest the fee, and I say so rather than stretch the record. The rider named the correct tower in the chat log — 'I am at Tower B ride-hail pickup' at 13:05:05 and 'Please come to Tower B' at 13:06:35 — and the trace shows the driver never moved from 219.77 m out before cancelling at 13:10:30, so POL-NS-03 limb (i), not limb (ii), governs the fault allocation: the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full and no driver compensation is payable, limb (ii)'s pin-ambiguity goodwill being conditioned on neither party having specified a sub-location.

Any refund is confined to the cancellation-fee line: fare_breakdown itemises the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee as the only chargeable line (base_fare 0.00, platform_fee 0.00, tolls_erp 0.00, waiting_time_fee 0.00, total_charged 4.00, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). The contested amount is SGD 4.00 and nothing beyond it is in issue in this ruling.

No integrity defect attaches to this record and none may be read against the driver. The SGD 4.00 fee equals the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone fee (4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (4.00) under fee_schedule.resolution_rule, so the fare reconciles exactly and POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged; the trace covers the window at 100% with 34 fixes, no gaps and rider_track present; and the chat log holds 4 messages matching trip_record.chat_message_count, so POL-NS-08(b) and (c) are not engaged either. The dispute turns on the substantive clauses alone.

Rider and driver: the SGD 4.00 no-show cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-09105 is refunded in full to the rider, and no compensation is payable to the driver.

Why the fee does not stand. The driver's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-09105) places him stationary at 219.77 m from the Tower B pickup pin for the entire record — 34 fixes from 13:05:00 to 13:10:30, speed 0.0 kph, trace distance 0.0 km, and zero fixes inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius (qualifying_fix_count 0, longest qualifying run 0.0 s). Under POL-NS-02 the driver is not deemed to have ARRIVED at the pickup point, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails and the fee is not chargeable. This is a wrong-entrance arrival governed by POL-NS-03: the driver was stationary outside the arrival radius but inside the 400 m ceiling (219.77 m), and held that position for 330 seconds, longer than the 300-second LARGE_VENUE dwell, so POL-NS-03 refunds the cancellation fee in full. Independently, the effective in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against the 300-second minimum — a 300-second shortfall — which under POL-NS-06 also makes the fee non-chargeable whether or not the rider was present.

Fault lies with the driver, so no compensation. The chat log (EV-CHAT-09105) shows the rider naming the sub-location — 'I am at Tower B ride-hail pickup' at 13:05:05 and 'That is the other entrance. Please come to Tower B.' at 13:06:35 — while the driver replied only that he was 'waiting at the mall taxi stand' at 13:06:00 and never moved before cancelling at 13:10:30. The driver's own filed statement concedes he 'did not move to Tower B'. Under POL-NS-03(i) the driver bears the loss and receives no compensation, so the POL-NS-07 payment of 80% (SGD 3.20 of SGD 4.00) is not payable. The driver-side claim that this is a wrong-face-of-same-venue case is accepted, but it leads to the same result: the fee is refunded and, because the rider specified the tower, limb (ii)'s pin-ambiguity goodwill of SGD 2.00 does not apply either.

The arrival marker is not false. At the 13:05:20 marker the driver was 219.77 m from the pin — inside POL-NS-05's 300 m trigger — and at 0.0 kph, below its 15 kph trigger, so POL-NS-05 does not engage at all; POL-NS-05 expressly sends a driver stationary within 300 m but outside the arrival radius to POL-NS-03. No false-arrival referral under POL-NS-05(ii) is entered against the driver. The rider's POL-NS-04 argument reaches the same outcome (full refund, no compensation) and changes nothing; on its own terms it is also doubtful, since the driver replied at 13:06:00 to the rider's 13:05:05 locating message, inside the 120-second window.

Amount. The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-09105) itemises the cancellation fee as the only chargeable line — base_fare 0.00, platform_fee 0.00, waiting_time_fee 0.00, tolls 0.00, total_charged SGD 4.00, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00. SGD 4.00 is also the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) under fee_schedule.resolution_rule, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect, and the full refund is SGD 4.00.

Integrity and escalation. The trace has 100% coverage, 34 fixes, no gaps and rider_track present; the chat log holds 4 messages matching trip_record.chat_message_count; the arrived 13:05:20 event matches the trace cadence. No limb of POL-NS-08 is engaged, no two artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence, and no POL-NS-09 trigger fires (the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check is not in play because the fee itself does not stand). Confidence is above the 0.70 floor. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09105-01 is MISSING (no payload, weight 0.0) and its absence cannot be used to sum separate in-geofence intervals under POL-NS-06(i); it carries nothing and does not affect the outcome.

Both sides read the record the same way, and so do I. The driver's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-09105, 34 fixes, 100% coverage, no gaps) places him 219.77 m from the Tower B pickup pin for the whole window 13:05:00–13:10:30, stationary — 0.0 kph on every fix. The arrival radius for this LARGE_VENUE pickup is 120 m, so the qualifying in-geofence fix count is 0 and the longest qualifying run is 0.0 s against the 300 s minimum dwell. POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c) therefore fail and the fee is not chargeable under that clause; POL-NS-02 likewise finds the driver never arrived at the pin.

That does not make this a driver who never came. He held position ~220 m from the pin — outside the 120 m arrival radius but inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling — for 330 seconds (13:05:00–13:10:30). This is the wrong-entrance case POL-NS-03 governs, and it refunds the cancellation fee to the rider in full.

Fault is allocated under POL-NS-03(i). The rider named the sub-location in the chat log: 'I am at Tower B ride-hail pickup, beside the blue sign' at 13:05:05 and 'That is the other entrance. Please come to Tower B.' at 13:06:35. A driver told the correct tower who does not move to it bears the loss and receives no compensation, so driver_compensation_sgd is null. POL-NS-03(ii)'s pin-ambiguity goodwill is not available because the rider did specify the tower, and the venue-identity point rests on the parties' own chat statements, not on any general geographic knowledge.

The rider side is right that POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails for lack of any in-radius fix and that POL-NS-06 independently yields a full refund on a 300 s in-geofence shortfall; POL-NS-06 adds nothing here beyond the same result. The rider's POL-NS-04 claim (contact unanswered by driver) is not a clean fit — the driver posted his 13:06:00 reply within 120 seconds of the rider's 13:05:05 locating message, and POL-NS-04's own closing sentence routes the residual mislocation to POL-NS-03 — but it changes nothing, because POL-NS-03(i) independently refunds the fee in full with no compensation.

A MISSING artifact carries no fact; its absence is citable and here it leaves the shortfall unexplained.

Who bears the cost. POL-NS-03(i) governs fault allocation. The rider named the sub-location in the chat log — 'I am at Tower B ride-hail pickup' at 13:05:05 and 'That is the other entrance. Please come to Tower B.' at 13:06:35 — and the driver, whose only reply (13:06:00) placed himself at the mall taxi stand, did not move before cancelling; he also concedes in his own filed statement that he 'did not move to Tower B'. The driver therefore bears the loss and receives no compensation, and POL-NS-07 is not reached because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full.

The SGD 4.00 equals the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect.

The refund is the cancellation-fee line only: fare_breakdown (EV-FARE-09105) shows cancellation_fee SGD 4.00, total_charged SGD 4.00, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and SGD 4.00 reconciles with the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), so no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect exists. The trace covers the window at 100% with no gaps and rider_track present, and the chat log holds all 4 messages trip_record records, so no POL-NS-08(a)–(d) impairment applies. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d 1, below 4; 30-day rate 0.008, below 0.08), so no escalation arises under POL-NS-07 or POL-NS-09. No profile field has been used as a ground of decision.

ledger.claim: The driver never reached the pickup point. His own trace of 34 fixes shows a nearest approach of 219.77 m and a farthest of 219.77 m — he is stationary roughly 220 m away for the whole trace — so the number of fixes inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius is zero (qualifying_fix_count 0, longest qualifying run 0.0 s). Under POL-NS-02 the driver is not deemed to have ARRIVED at the Tower B pin, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the cancellation fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01.

This is a wrong-entrance arrival, the situation POL-NS-03 governs. The trace shows the driver stationary at 219.77 m from the pickup pin — outside the 120 m arrival radius but inside the 400 m ceiling — continuously from 13:05:00 to 13:10:30, i.e. for 330 seconds, longer than the 300 second dwell required for this zone class. The driver did not arrive at the pickup point and the cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full.

The mislocation is the driver's, under POL-NS-03(i). The chat log shows the rider naming the sub-location at 13:05:05 — 'I am at Tower B ride-hail pickup, beside the blue sign.' — and again at 13:06:35: 'That is the other entrance. Please come to Tower B.' The driver answered at 13:06:00 only that he was 'waiting at the mall taxi stand', and his own filed statement concedes he 'did not move to Tower B'. A driver told the correct tower who does not move to it before cancelling bears the loss and receives no compensation.

Independently of the wrong-entrance analysis, the effective in-geofence dwell is zero seconds: run_count 0 and longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec 0.0 against the 300 second minimum for LARGE_VENUE — a shortfall of 300 seconds. Under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages.

Nothing on this record excuses the zero dwell. EV-ADVIS-09105-01 is MISSING, carries no payload and weighs 0.0, so no traffic advisory covers this pickup road. POL-NS-06 limb (i) requires a present and populated advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT before in-geofence intervals may be summed or a hold excused; on a MISSING advisory limb (i) is simply unavailable and the full refund stands.

The rider was present at the pin and actively coordinating, which removes the premise of a rider no-show. Her track carries 16 qualifying fixes, all about 25 m from the pickup pin, across 13:05:30 to 13:10:30 — far inside the 150 m rider-presence radius for LARGE_VENUE. Her 13:06:35 message asked the driver to come to Tower B; the driver posted no reply to that locating instruction within 120 seconds and made no in-app call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty) before terminating at 13:10:30, so POL-NS-04 refunds the fee in full with no driver compensation. The driver's only chat reply, at 13:06:00, answered nothing about the correct entrance and preceded the instruction to move.

The sum to return is the cancellation-fee line only. The fare breakdown shows cancellation_fee SGD 4.00 against total_charged SGD 4.00, with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00; SGD 4.00 is also the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect and SGD 4.00 is the amount refundable to the rider.

The governing clause here is POL-NS-03, not POL-NS-01: the driver's own trace is a single stationary point — 34 fixes, min = max = mean 219.77 m from the pickup pin, distinct speed 0.0 kph, trace_distance_km 0.0 — held from 13:05:00 to 13:10:30. That places him outside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails; but 219.77 m is well inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling, so this is a wrong-entrance case decided under POL-NS-03, not a no-show under POL-NS-01.

The 13:05:20 arrival marker is not a false marker and must not be recorded as one: at that timestamp the driver's nearest fix is 219.77 m from the pin — below POL-NS-05's 300 m trigger — and his recorded speed is 0.0 kph — below the 15 kph trigger — so POL-NS-05 does not engage at all. A driver stationary within 300 m of the pin but outside the arrival radius when marking arrival is expressly decided under POL-NS-03, and no false-arrival entry under POL-NS-05(ii) may be entered against this driver.

The driver was at the venue, not absent from it. His own chat message at 13:06:00 states 'I am waiting at the mall taxi stand', and the rider's reply at 13:06:35 characterises that as 'the other entrance' — party statements in the chat log, which POL-NS-03 permits as the basis for a venue-identity finding, no general geographic knowledge being used. This is a wrong face of the same large venue (registered_pickup_points 3), not a driver who never came to the pickup.

The driver did not cancel early and did not abandon the pickup: he held position for the entire window from 13:05:00 to 13:10:30 (330 seconds, 0.0 kph on every one of the 34 fixes), and trip_record itself credits a 5.2-minute wait. The 300-second shortfall recorded in derived.arrival therefore arises only from where he held — the wrong entrance — and not from any premature termination of the wait.

The driver does not contest the fee, and I say so rather than stretch the record. The rider named the correct tower in the chat log — 'I am at Tower B ride-hail pickup' at 13:05:05 and 'Please come to Tower B' at 13:06:35 — and the trace shows the driver never moved from 219.77 m out before cancelling at 13:10:30, so POL-NS-03 limb (i), not limb (ii), governs the fault allocation: the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full and no driver compensation is payable, limb (ii)'s pin-ambiguity goodwill being conditioned on neither party having specified a sub-location.

Any refund is confined to the cancellation-fee line: fare_breakdown itemises the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee as the only chargeable line (base_fare 0.00, platform_fee 0.00, tolls_erp 0.00, waiting_time_fee 0.00, total_charged 4.00, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). The contested amount is SGD 4.00 and nothing beyond it is in issue in this ruling.

No integrity defect attaches to this record and none may be read against the driver. The SGD 4.00 fee equals the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone fee (4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (4.00) under fee_schedule.resolution_rule, so the fare reconciles exactly and POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged; the trace covers the window at 100% with 34 fixes, no gaps and rider_track present; and the chat log holds 4 messages matching trip_record.chat_message_count, so POL-NS-08(b) and (c) are not engaged either. The dispute turns on the substantive clauses alone.
